summary: Created the initial sprint workstreams for architecture, backend API, and the static frontend; database, QA, and security will be delegated in the next available agent slots.

Implement a single static HTML vanilla-JS Kanban UI

messages.content: Provide the contract promptly so implementation work can align.
Proceed with a standard-library-only REST API; await architecture guidance if needed.
Proceed with a single-file vanilla-JS UI and align to the API contract when available.

blockers: Only three delegate slots are available while the manager is active; database, QA, and security delegation is queued until slots free.
decisions: Use Python standard library only, with sqlite3 for persistence and a single static HTML frontend.
Keep the API and UI lightweight with no external packages or build tooling.
